title: Xanthe and the Crown
premise: Isandro Halloran, a debt-bound scribe for the Guild of Impossible Things, discovers their ledgers hide the true account of King Aldric's coronation: he was bound to a sentient crown that trades memory for power. When the border wards collapse and the stars go out, Isandro realizes the crown has been feeding on dragon-fire—the last source keeping the world lit. With a disgraced ward-keeper named Sefa and the king's estranged daughter, Isandro must reach the palace and unbind Aldric before the final flame dies. They succeed at terrible cost: Isandro takes the crown's debt into themselves, freeing the king but binding their own fate to Sefa and the found family who refuse to let them carry it alone.
about_author: Lior Dravenmoor is the pen name of a former archivist who spent a decade cataloguing other people's secrets before deciding to invent better ones. They write fantasy about ledgers, loyalty, and the quiet people history forgets to record.

chapters.title: The Ledger of Small Debts
chapters.summary: In Isandro's POV, we see their invisible life among the Guild's impossible inventory—bottled storms, borrowed years—until they notice entries in the royal ledger that shouldn't exist: payments made in memories. That night, the border wards fall and the stars go out simultaneously. The Guild master orders all records sealed. Emotional beat: dread blooming from routine, as Isandro realizes invisibility was always an illusion.

chapters.title: What the Crown Remembers
chapters.summary: Alternating between Isandro and Sefa, the disgraced ward-keeper who arrives hunting answers about the fallen wards. Together they decode the ledger: the crown is alive, consuming dragon-fire to sustain King Aldric's borrowed authority—and the king's daughter, Princess Veyra, has been exiled for asking too many questions. The three form an uneasy alliance. Emotional beat: wary trust kindling between strangers bound by what they've each lost.

chapters.title: The Last Dragon-Fire
chapters.summary: Climax in Veyra's POV as the trio infiltrates the darkened palace while the world dims around them. They find Aldric hollowed out, barely himself, and confront the crown directly—it offers Isandro everything they've ever been denied in exchange for walking away. In the binding chamber, Isandro performs the unbinding ritual as the final dragon-fire gutters, transferring the crown's debt into their own name. Emotional beat: sacrifice chosen freely, love outweighing duty.

chapters.title: A Debt Shared Is Halved
chapters.summary: Resolution in Isandro's POV: the stars return one by one, Aldric abdicates to Veyra, and the Guild's ledgers are opened to public reckoning. The crown's debt should consume Isandro—but Sefa and Veyra invoke an old guild law, splitting it three ways, converting ruin into obligation they can live with. Isandro, no longer invisible, begins writing a new ledger under their own name. Emotional beat: quiet hope; found family as the answer to power's corruption.
